cues.text: Find Rice across the middle, and Arsenal have their first connection.
Push on with Rice; the ball travels forward at his feet.
Carry it up the flank! Martinelli advances from Calafiori's delivery.
Shift across through Odegaard, and Saka receives on the opposite flank.
Cut out by Doku! Timber's ball across the pitch changes hands.
Bring it inside to Kovacic after Doku's advance down the flank.
Drive through the middle with Cherki after Ait-Nouri brings the ball inward.
Intercepted by Saliba! Haaland's next ball stays with Arsenal.
Work out through Gabriel; Zubimendi receives the next ball inside.
Step forward with Zubimendi, keeping the ball near the middle.
Sweep it across! Martinelli redirects Rice's wide delivery toward Odegaard.
Take it forward, Saka! Odegaard's wide connection becomes a carry.
Gyokeres scores! Saka's ball inward is followed by the opener.
Restart through Anderson, then out toward Lewis on the flank.
Advance with Foden! Lewis's ball down the flank becomes forward movement.
Carry centrally with Anderson after Guehi returns the ball inside.
Rice takes it! Cherki's pass is intercepted in the middle.
Go wide through Calafiori; Martinelli receives farther up the same flank.
Bring it inward, then advance! Gyokeres carries on from Martinelli's pass.
Return to the flank through Timber, with Saka receiving farther forward.
Ait-Nouri intercepts! Saka's ball across the pitch reaches City instead.
Move inside, then wide again; Anderson finds Doku after Ait-Nouri's pass.
Send it across to Cherki! Doku changes the angle after carrying up the flank.
Haaland scores the equalizer! Cherki's inward pass precedes the finish.
Start again through Gabriel, with Zubimendi sending the restart backward.
Turn the route inward through Rice, then carry forward from Calafiori's pass.
Cross the pitch through Odegaard; Saka receives out on the other flank.
Guehi cuts it out! Saka's inward ball brings another change of possession.
Take it up the flank with Lewis after Dias sends the ball outward.
Come back inside through Kovacic, then across the middle to Cherki.
Spread it to Doku! Cherki's central carry ends with a ball toward the flank.
Timber intercepts across the pitch! Doku's next pass changes possession.
Work inward through Zubimendi, then across to Rice from Timber's outlet.
Advance along the flank! Martinelli carries forward after Calafiori finds him.
Bring it inside to Gyokeres, then back across toward Odegaard.
Anderson takes over! Odegaard's pass is intercepted near the middle.
Exit through Ait-Nouri and out to Doku; City move from the middle to the flank.
Keep moving with Doku, carrying forward along the same flank.
Angle inward through Kovacic; Cherki receives across from Doku's route.
Find the other flank! Cherki sends the ball outward to Foden.

chapters.heading: Across, then forward
chapters.fan: The ball has crossed from Martinelli's flank to Saka's, and now the movement goes forward again.
chapters.analyst: Martinelli's pass traverses the pitch toward Odegaard. The next pass takes it wider to Saka, whose carry continues along that flank.

chapters.heading: The switch changes hands
chapters.fan: Arsenal send the ball back from Saka, but Doku takes possession on Timber's next pass.
chapters.analyst: Saka's return moves the ball backward along his flank. Timber's subsequent pass crosses much of the pitch and is intercepted by Doku.

chapters.heading: Out wide, across, out wide
chapters.fan: Arsenal connect both flanks again, with Saka now receiving the move on the opposite side.
chapters.analyst: Rice finds Martinelli wide before the ball travels across to Odegaard and outward to Saka. The sequence changes width without a carry between these passes.

chapters.heading: Gyokeres opens the scoring
chapters.fan: There is the breakthrough: Saka brings the move forward and inward, and Gyokeres scores.
chapters.analyst: Saka carries along the flank before passing across toward the centre at a similar forward position. Gyokeres then shoots into the goal.

chapters.heading: A restart takes the flank
chapters.fan: City's restart has become a forward carry, with Foden taking the movement down the flank.
chapters.analyst: Anderson sends the restart outward to Lewis. Lewis connects with Foden farther toward City's attacking end, and Foden continues in that direction.

chapters.heading: Rice breaks the central route
chapters.fan: City bring the ball through the middle, but Rice takes possession on Cherki's next connection.
chapters.analyst: Anderson carries centrally and finds Cherki nearby. Cherki's attempted pass shifts across the middle, where Rice intercepts.

chapters.heading: Haaland brings City level
chapters.fan: The equalizer arrives through Haaland after City's move travels from Doku's flank back into the middle.
chapters.analyst: Doku carries forward before passing across to Cherki. Cherki redirects the ball toward Haaland in a more central position, and Haaland scores.

chapters.heading: Back first, then forward
chapters.fan: Arsenal restart backward, reconnect out wide, and bring Rice forward with the ball.
chapters.analyst: The restart goes to Gabriel before moving outward through Calafiori. Rice receives inward from the flank and carries toward Arsenal's attacking end.

chapters.heading: Guehi interrupts the inward ball
chapters.fan: Saka has carried farther along the flank, but the next ball belongs to Guehi.
chapters.analyst: The sequence crosses from Martinelli through Odegaard to Saka. After advancing wide, Saka attempts an inward pass that Guehi intercepts.

chapters.heading: The route reaches Martinelli
chapters.fan: Arsenal move across from Timber's side and turn the connection into another Martinelli carry.
chapters.analyst: Timber's pass comes inward to Zubimendi. Rice and Calafiori move it toward the opposite flank, where Martinelli receives and carries forward.

chapters.heading: Anderson takes the next ball
chapters.fan: The move comes inward through Gyokeres, then changes hands as Anderson intercepts Odegaard's pass.
chapters.analyst: Martinelli finds Gyokeres centrally before the ball moves backward and across to Odegaard. Odegaard's next pass travels toward the middle and reaches Anderson.

chapters.heading: From Doku's side to Foden
chapters.fan: City connect the flanks through the middle, ending this passage with Foden receiving wide.
chapters.analyst: Doku carries on one flank, then passes inward to Kovacic. The next connections through Cherki and Foden take the ball across toward the opposite flank.
